messages:
Maya Chen: Quick question — my corporate card was blocked for a dinner in Berlin (attempted txn €184). I uploaded the receipt but the reimbursement says 'pending manager approval'. Any tip on speeding up?
Carlos Rivera: Sorry, were you on a company trip? We need pre-approval for meals >€100 unless it's emergency. Did you file the travel authorization?
Maya Chen: Yes, travel auth was filed under T-2026-041, but I forgot to tick the "meal overage" box. I attached receipt: https://internal.redwood/expenses/upload/ABC123
Ava Patel: @Maya Chen I can approve manually if this was within policy. Can you paste the itemized receipt line for alcohol? policy only approves non-alcohol meals.
Maya Chen: Itemized lines: Food €120, Drinks €30, Service €34. Alcohol was part of the drinks.
Sam Li: @Ava Patel if we approve, should we code to 'client-entertainment' or 'team-meal'? This was client dinner.
Ava Patel: Code as client-entertainment. Maya, finance will reimburse the non-alcohol portion; for alcohol we need manager signoff and it may be taxable. Confirm if any alcohol was for client?
Maya Chen: It was mostly water/soft drinks for client, 2 beers only. Happy to cover those if policy requires.
finance-bot: Expense ABC123 status updated to 'manager_approval_requested' (cc @Ava Patel).
Ava Patel: @Sam Li can you sign off on the alcohol portion? Otherwise we reimburse €154 (food+service) and Maya covers €30 drinks.
Sam Li: Approved. I sign off for exception — client dinner, reimbursable.
Ava Patel: Thanks. @Maya Chen reimburse will be processed in next payroll run. Please upload the VAT invoice if you have it (needed for EUR claims).
Maya Chen: Uploading VAT copy now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Carlos Rivera: FYI for future trips, put the meal overage checkbox on travel auth and flag the client dinner in notes. saves time.
Maya Chen: Noted, will do.
finance-bot: Expense ABC123 status updated to 'approved' — estimated reimbursement €184. Reimbursement ETA: next payroll batch (2 business days).
